title: Consolidated build branches and repaired legacy moderation reads
statement: Merged memory, planning, base Commons, PDF and Observatory workspace PRs under Achim's explicit merge instruction. Publication repairs were integrated into the multi-entry branch. Reproduced and repaired normal-reader moderation leakage across inherited room/HTTP/MCP/orchestration projections without rewriting stored events.
conditions: The referenced context packet is a dated orientation at 93a5445; current source and branch heads were inspected separately.
Integration and repair tests are coordinator verification, not independent review or human product acceptance.
Merging a proposal file does not accept its claims or change source-owned decisions.
Local moderation does not retract externally published content; public deployment and account activation remain outside this work.
